prompts.name: pin
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: ONE transparent navigation icon for Machinista, a professional musical groovebox. Subject: an upright pushpin, broad geometric cap, short stem, clear point. Style: premium flat geometric interface pictogram, perfectly front-facing, crisp clean shapes and restrained rounded corners, matching an industrial electronic instrument. Palette: bright warm orange #ff8000 accents and near-white #f1f4f7 main shapes only. Absolutely no dark background: real transparent alpha everywhere outside the icon. Composition: one centered standalone icon, square canvas, generous equal transparent margins, consistent visual weight, simple silhouette legible when reduced to 64 by 64 pixels. Use broad strokes and bold solids, very few interior details. No typography, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no enclosing app badge or tile, no photorealism, no texture, no perspective, no gradients, no glow, no drop shadow, no extra objects. This must work alongside seven other matching pictograms on dark navy controller displays. Create only this single pin icon.
